android.extraProguardRules:
# OkHttp (via React Native networking) references optional TLS providers that are
# never on the runtime classpath. AGP 8 escalates the missing-class warning to a
# build failure, so they are silenced explicitly rather than left to chance.
-dontwarn org.conscrypt.**
-dontwarn org.bouncycastle.**
-dontwarn org.openjsse.**

# Hermes + Expo module registries resolve these through JNI/reflection, so R8
# cannot see the call sites and would otherwise strip them.
-keepclasseswithmembernames class * { native <methods>; }

extra._comment_api: Points at the shared hosting deployment so the APK works without a laptop. For local development against Laragon use http://10.0.2.2:8000/api/v1 (Android emulator) or http://<LAN-IP>:8000/api/v1 (physical device), then rebuild.
extra._comment_reverb: Shared hosting cannot run `php artisan reverb:start` (no supervisor/systemd/screen), so this socket will not connect there and useRealtime() falls back to a 10s refetch. Requirement 3 is only met on a host that can keep the Reverb process alive.
extra._comment_demoMode: When true, src/features/demo/router.ts answers every API call from an in-memory fabricated dataset — no server, no database, no network (see src/features/demo/config.ts). This is what lets a release APK demonstrate the full flow standalone; DemoBanner shows MODE DEMO — DATA TIDAK NYATA on every screen whenever this is true. Set to false and rebuild for any build that must talk to the real backend above.
